commands.requires: All pinned archives safely extracted into a merged isolated root preserving exact ledger member paths; source/root recovery completed.
argv: import json; from pathlib import Path; from tools.build_corrective_ledger import historical_inventory; historical_inventory(Path('/workspace/corrective-reassembly'),json.loads(Path('C7_Final_Ledger_v2.json').read_text())['evidence_objects'])

commands.requires: Historical inventory and integrated mapping review finished; all evaluation source final; no prior file at new freeze path. Freeze must be committed before full run.
argv: import hashlib,json; from pathlib import Path; r=Path('.'); out=r/'C7_Corrective_Final_Source_Freeze_v1.json'; assert not out.exists(); files={p for p in r.rglob('*.py') if '.git' not in p.parts and not any(x.startswith('evidence') for x in p.parts)}; files|={p for f in ('tools','contracts') for p in (r/f).rglob('*') if p.is_file() and '__pycache__' not in p.parts}; out.write_text(json.dumps({str(p):hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in sorted(files)},indent=2)+'\n')

failure_policy: Never reuse a failed or source-changed full attempt; preserve it and apply standing stop rules. Resume successful jobs only on exact unchanged freeze.
afterwards: Independent final release decision and clean source/evidence unpack, all immutable historical components and newly saved corrective/full-run archives, inspector/reproduce and durable delivery checks still mandatory. No completion claim from this command list.
source_side_raw_dependency: Restore and hash-check evidence/FB5.6/attempt4/matrix/iee-04-same-target-recurrence.json.gz at its repository-relative path from pinned FB5.6 archive before corrective tests/export. It is currently locally verified. Do not regenerate it as history.
